messages:
Lena: Quick check-in on customer comms for the Apr 22 outage. Need: short statuspage blurb, 72h public summary, and a clear policy sentence for RCA access. Also capture owners + deadlines so action tracker is tidy.

Carlos: I can draft the 2-line status blurb. Propose to keep it factual and avoid technical details.

Maya: I'll own the 72h summary (public variant). Devon, can you take enterprise-targeted summary/outreach?

Devon: Yup, enterprise outreach owned. ETA for initial draft: 2024-04-26 COB. Will include account-level note templates and suggested CS responses.

Carlos: Proposed statuspage copy: 
```
Status: Partial service disruption — Resolved
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint failed or returned elevated latency. We mitigated the immediate issue and service is operating normally.
```

Elsa: Suggest replacing "failed" with "experienced errors" and add: "We are investigating root cause and will post a summary within 72 hours." Keeps tone softer.

Carlos: Updated: 
```
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced errors and higher latency. We mitigated the immediate impact and service is operating normally. We are investigating and will post a summary within 72 hours.
```

Maya: For the 72h public summary, planned outline: timeline, impact, mitigation steps, next steps (short), and note about RCA availability. I'll loop Legal for redaction review once draft is ready.

Lena: RCA access policy: propose default = public redacted summary on status page; detailed RCA available to verified impacted customers via support request. If details are sensitive, require an NDA or redaction at Legal discretion. Who can own the policy text?

Elsa: I can draft the policy sentence. Suggest language: "A redacted summary is available publicly; impacted customers may request a detailed RCA through Support. Sensitive detail may be redacted or shared under NDA"

incident-bot: Ticket INC-4622 created: "rca-sharing-policy-and-comms" assigned to Elsa. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-4622

Devon: Enterprise outreach draft ETA 2024-04-26 COB. Will include an offer for a private briefing for customers with material impact.

Maya: 72h public summary ETA 2024-04-26 17:00 PT. I'll add a short recurring-incident note: this incident appears related to periodic KV cache evictions we've tracked.

Carlos: Small ops ask: statuspage sentence about how to request more info. Proposed addendum: "To request a detailed RCA, contact Support and reference incident #INC-4618." Good?

Lena: Change to reference new ticket: use INC-4622 (the RCA policy ticket).

Carlos: Done. Will push statuspage copy to staging after Elsa's policy sentence lands. Target publish time: 2024-04-25 18:00 PT.

Devon: For recurring pattern ownership: I'll create a follow-up SRE task and tag Platform SRE. ETA for initial mitigation plan: 2024-05-08.

incident-bot: Follow-up task TASK-8911 created and assigned to Devon. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/TASK-8911

Elsa: Drafted policy sentence and sent to Legal at 2024-04-24 14:10 PT. Legal asked for one minor tweak on wording around NDA.

Maya: Good. Small action list:
- Statuspage copy: Carlos -> publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT
- 72h public summary: Maya -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT
- Enterprise outreach + briefing offers: Devon -> 2024-04-26 COB
- RCA policy blurb: Elsa -> legal approval by 2024-04-28
- Recurrence mitigation plan: Devon/SRE -> 2024-05-08

Lena: I'll add these to the incident action tracker and send reminders. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to sign off on final copy. :calendar:

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1719772200 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
